package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

type acceptanceFake struct {
	mu       sync.Mutex
	calls    [][]string
	next     int
	failSend bool
}

func (f *acceptanceFake) Call(command []byte) ([]byte, error) {
	f.mu.Lock()
	defer f.mu.Unlock()
	p := strings.Split(string(command), BeeNTSeparator)
	f.calls = append(f.calls, p)
	switch p[0] {
	case "1":
		return []byte(`{"user_id":"999","nickname":"机器人"}`), nil
	case "73":
		return []byte("BeeNT"), nil
	case "74":
		return []byte("0.1"), nil
	case "75":
		return []byte("999"), nil
	case "3", "4", "82", "83":
		if f.failSend {
			return []byte("发送失败"), nil
		}
		f.next++
		return []byte(strconv.Itoa(f.next)), nil
	case "42":
		return nil, nil
	}
	return nil, errors.New("unexpected operation")
}
func (f *acceptanceFake) snapshot() [][]string {
	f.mu.Lock()
	defer f.mu.Unlock()
	result := make([][]string, len(f.calls))
	for i, p := range f.calls {
		result[i] = append([]string(nil), p...)
	}
	return result
}
func (f *acceptanceFake) clear() { f.mu.Lock(); f.calls = nil; f.mu.Unlock() }
func acceptanceFixture(t *testing.T) (*acceptancePlugin, *acceptanceFake, string) {
	t.Helper()
	fake := &acceptanceFake{}
	dir := t.TempDir()
	p := newAcceptancePlugin(dir, func() (*BeeNTAPI, error) { return NewBeeNTAPIWithTransport(7, fake) })
	p.initialize()
	p.enable()
	fake.clear()
	t.Cleanup(p.disable)
	return p, fake, dir
}

func TestAcceptanceRoutesOnlyExplicitCommandsAndPreservesEcho(t *testing.T) {
	p, f, _ := acceptanceFixture(t)
	for _, message := range []string{"hello", "/beentish ping", "/beentping", "prefix /beent ping"} {
		if p.message(false, "123", "123", message, "-1") != MessageContinue {
			t.Fatal("unexpected intercept")
		}
	}
	if len(f.snapshot()) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("unrequested message sent")
	}
	p.message(false, "123", "123", "/beent ping", "-1")
	p.message(true, "456", "123", "/beent echo 中文😀\n第二行  \n", "-2")
	calls := f.snapshot()
	if len(calls) != 2 || calls[0][0] != "3" || calls[0][2] != "123" || calls[0][3] != "PONG" || calls[1][0] != "4" || calls[1][2] != "456" || DecodeFrameworkText(calls[1][3]) != "中文😀\n第二行  \n" {
		t.Fatalf("calls=%q", calls)
	}
	f.clear()
	p.message(true, "456", "999", "/beent ping", "-3")
	if len(f.snapshot()) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("replied to own message")
	}
}

func TestAcceptanceQuoteAndRecallOnlyPluginMessageID(t *testing.T) {
	p, f, _ := acceptanceFixture(t)
	p.message(true, "456", "123", "/beent quote", "-200")
	calls := f.snapshot()
	if len(calls) != 1 || calls[0][0] != "83" || calls[0][2] != "456" || calls[0][3] != "-200" {
		t.Fatalf("quote=%q", calls)
	}
	f.clear()
	p.message(true, "456", "123", "/beent ping", "-201")
	sent := f.snapshot()[0]
	pluginID := strconv.Itoa(f.next)
	if sent[0] != "4" {
		t.Fatalf("send=%q", sent)
	}
	f.clear()
	p.message(false, "123", "123", "/beent recall", "-202")
	for _, call := range f.snapshot() {
		if call[0] == "42" {
			t.Fatal("recalled another source")
		}
	}
	f.clear()
	p.message(true, "456", "123", "/beent recall", "-203")
	found := false
	for _, call := range f.snapshot() {
		if call[0] == "42" {
			found = true
			if call[2] != pluginID || call[2] == "-203" {
				t.Fatalf("recalled %q", call)
			}
		}
	}
	if !found {
		t.Fatal("no plugin message recalled")
	}
	f.mu.Lock()
	f.failSend = true
	f.mu.Unlock()
	f.clear()
	p.message(true, "789", "123", "/beent ping", "-204")
	p.message(true, "789", "123", "/beent recall", "-205")
	for _, call := range f.snapshot() {
		if call[0] == "42" {
			t.Fatalf("business failure used as message ID: %q", call)
		}
	}
}

func TestAcceptanceRecallImmediatelyAfterQuoteUsesQuotedReplyID(t *testing.T) {
	p, f, _ := acceptanceFixture(t)
	p.message(true, "456", "123", "/beent ping", "-1")
	p.message(true, "456", "123", "/beent quote", "-2")
	quoteID := strconv.Itoa(f.next)
	f.clear()
	p.message(true, "456", "123", "/beent recall", "-3")
	calls := f.snapshot()
	if len(calls) < 1 || calls[0][0] != "42" || calls[0][2] != quoteID {
		t.Fatalf("recall=%q want quote ID=%q", calls, quoteID)
	}
}

func TestAcceptanceQuoteUsesPrivateAndGroupReplyOperations(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name           string
		group          bool
		source, opcode string
	}{{"private", false, "123", "82"}, {"group", true, "456", "83"}} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			p, f, _ := acceptanceFixture(t)
			p.message(tc.group, tc.source, "123", "/beent quote", "-999")
			calls := f.snapshot()
			if len(calls) != 1 || calls[0][0] != tc.opcode || calls[0][2] != tc.source || calls[0][3] != "-999" || calls[0][4] != "BeeNT Go 引用测试" {
				t.Fatalf("quote=%q", calls)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestAcceptanceDataCounterSurvivesNewInstance(t *testing.T) {
	p, f, dir := acceptanceFixture(t)
	p.message(false, "123", "123", "/beent data", "1")
	q := newAcceptancePlugin(dir, func() (*BeeNTAPI, error) { return NewBeeNTAPIWithTransport(7, f) })
	q.initialize()
	q.enable()
	t.Cleanup(q.disable)
	q.message(false, "123", "123", "/beent data", "2")
	raw, e := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, "acceptance_state.json"))
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	var state struct {
		Count int `json:"count"`
	}
	if e = json.Unmarshal(raw, &state); e != nil || state.Count != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("state=%s error=%v", raw, e)
	}
}

func TestAcceptanceDisableCancelsDelayedSourceReply(t *testing.T) {
	p, f, dir := acceptanceFixture(t)
	p.message(true, "456", "123", "/beent bg 延迟😀\n下一行", "1")
	p.disable()
	f.clear()
	time.Sleep(2100 * time.Millisecond)
	if len(f.snapshot()) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("background call survived disable: %q", f.snapshot())
	}
	raw, e := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, "acceptance.log"))
	if e != nil || !strings.Contains(string(raw), "background_cancelled") {
		t.Fatalf("cancel log=%s error=%v", raw, e)
	}
}

func TestAcceptanceBackgroundUsesOriginalTarget(t *testing.T) {
	p, f, _ := acceptanceFixture(t)
	p.message(false, "123", "123", "/beent bg 原文😀", "1")
	f.clear()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(3 * time.Second)
	for len(f.snapshot()) == 0 && time.Now().Before(deadline) {
		time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond)
	}
	calls := f.snapshot()
	if len(calls) != 1 || calls[0][0] != "3" || calls[0][2] != "123" || DecodeFrameworkText(calls[0][3]) != "原文😀" {
		t.Fatalf("background=%q", calls)
	}
}

func TestAcceptanceEventOptInAndRawLogs(t *testing.T) {
	p, f, dir := acceptanceFixture(t)
	p.event("5", "group", "name", "trigger", "opname", "operator", "内容😀", "flag")
	if len(f.snapshot()) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("default event spam")
	}
	p.message(false, "123", "123", "/beent event on", "1")
	f.clear()
	p.event("5", "group", "name", "trigger", "opname", "operator", "内容😀", "flag")
	calls := f.snapshot()
	if len(calls) != 1 || calls[0][0] != "3" || calls[0][2] != "123" {
		t.Fatalf("event target=%q", calls)
	}
	p.message(false, "123", "123", "/beent event off", "2")
	f.clear()
	p.event("30", "", "", "", "", "", "disconnected", "")
	if len(f.snapshot()) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("event off did not stop notification")
	}
	raw, e := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, "acceptance.log"))
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	hasEvent, hasAPI := false, false
	for _, line := range strings.Split(strings.TrimSpace(string(raw)), "\n") {
		var record map[string]any
		if e = json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &record); e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		if record["kind"] == "event" {
			hasEvent = true
			if fields, ok := record["fields"].([]any); !ok || len(fields) != 8 {
				t.Fatalf("event lost fields: %v", record)
			}
		}
		if record["kind"] == "api" {
			hasAPI = true
			if _, ok := record["result"]; !ok {
				t.Fatalf("missing raw result %v", record)
			}
			if _, ok := record["error"]; !ok {
				t.Fatalf("missing error %v", record)
			}
		}
	}
	if !hasEvent || !hasAPI {
		t.Fatalf("missing records event=%v api=%v", hasEvent, hasAPI)
	}
}

func TestAcceptanceInterceptionIsExplicit(t *testing.T) {
	p, _, _ := acceptanceFixture(t)
	if p.message(false, "123", "123", "/beent intercept", "1") != MessageIntercept {
		t.Fatal("intercept missing")
	}
	if p.message(false, "123", "123", "/beent ping", "2") != MessageContinue {
		t.Fatal("ping intercepted")
	}
}

func TestAcceptanceInfoAndIDsExposeExactCurrentContext(t *testing.T) {
	p, f, _ := acceptanceFixture(t)
	p.message(true, "000456", "123", "/beent id", "-9223372036854775808")
	calls := f.snapshot()
	if len(calls) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("id calls=%q", calls)
	}
	var fields map[string]string
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(strings.TrimPrefix(calls[0][3], "消息参数: ")), &fields); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if fields["kind"] != "group" || fields["source_id"] != "000456" || fields["user_id"] != "123" || fields["message_id"] != "-9223372036854775808" || fields["message"] != "/beent id" {
		t.Fatalf("ID fields=%v", fields)
	}
	f.clear()
	p.message(false, "123", "123", "/beent info", "2")
	calls = f.snapshot()
	if len(calls) != 5 || calls[0][0] != "73" || calls[1][0] != "74" || calls[2][0] != "75" || calls[3][0] != "1" || calls[4][0] != "3" {
		t.Fatalf("info calls=%q", calls)
	}
	var info struct {
		Name    string    `json:"framework_name"`
		Version string    `json:"framework_version"`
		QQ      string    `json:"framework_qq"`
		Robot   RobotInfo `json:"robot_info"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(strings.TrimPrefix(calls[4][3], "框架信息: ")), &info); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if info.Name != "BeeNT" || info.Version != "0.1" || info.QQ != "999" || info.Robot.UserID != "999" || info.Robot.Nickname != "机器人" {
		t.Fatalf("info=%+v", info)
	}
}

func TestAcceptanceBusinessFailureRemainsRawInLog(t *testing.T) {
	p, f, dir := acceptanceFixture(t)
	f.mu.Lock()
	f.failSend = true
	f.mu.Unlock()
	p.message(false, "123", "123", "/beent ping", "1")
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, "acceptance.log"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	found := false
	for _, line := range strings.Split(strings.TrimSpace(string(raw)), "\n") {
		var record map[string]any
		if err = json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &record); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if record["kind"] == "api" && record["result"] == "发送失败" {
			found = true
			if record["error"] != "" {
				t.Fatalf("business failure mislabeled IPC error: %v", record)
			}
		}
	}
	if !found {
		t.Fatal("raw host business failure was not recorded")
	}
}
